description: Utility functions for handling and analyzing posts in Mattermost Redux, including post type checks, permission checks, sorting, and metadata extraction.

methods.name: isSystemMessage
methods.description: Checks if a post is a system message based on its type prefix.

methods.name: isMeMessage
methods.description: Checks if a post is a 'me' message.

methods.name: isFromWebhook
methods.description: Determines if a post originated from a webhook.

methods.name: isPostEphemeral
methods.description: Checks if a post is ephemeral or deleted.

methods.name: isUserAddedInChannel
methods.description: Checks if a post indicates a user was added to a channel.

methods.name: shouldIgnorePost
methods.description: Determines if a post should be ignored based on its type.

methods.name: isUserActivityPost
methods.description: Checks if a post type is a user activity post.

methods.name: isPostOwner
methods.description: Checks if a user is the owner of a post.

methods.name: isEdited
methods.description: Checks if a post has been edited.

methods.name: canEditPost
methods.description: Determines if a user can edit a post based on permissions, license, and time limits.

methods.name: getLastCreateAt
methods.description: Returns the latest creation timestamp among a list of posts.

methods.name: shouldFilterJoinLeavePost
methods.description: Decides if a join/leave post should be filtered based on user preferences.

methods.name: isJoinLeavePostForUsername
methods.description: Checks if a join/leave post is related to a specific username.

methods.name: isPostPendingOrFailed
methods.description: Checks if a post is pending or has failed.

methods.name: comparePosts
methods.description: Compares two posts for sorting, prioritizing pending/failed and creation time.

methods.name: isPostCommentMention
methods.description: Determines if a post mentions a comment or user based on notification preferences.

methods.name: fromAutoResponder
methods.description: Checks if a post is an auto-responder system message.

methods.name: getEmbedFromMetadata
methods.description: Extracts the first embed from post metadata.

methods.name: isPermalink
methods.description: Checks if a post contains a permalink embed.

methods.name: shouldUpdatePost
methods.description: Determines if a received post should update a stored post based on timestamps and metadata.

methods.name: ensureString
methods.description: Ensures a value is a string, defaulting to empty string.

methods.name: ensureNumber
methods.description: Ensures a value is a number, defaulting to zero.

methods.name: secureGetFromRecord
methods.description: Safely retrieves a value from a record by key.
